description_en: Switches between the internal and public endpoints of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 切换AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的内外网地址
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb switch-db-instance-net-type --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --connection-string-prefix gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --port 5432 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SwitchDBInstanceNetType

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361776.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361776.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the custom endpoint.

The prefix can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-) and must start with a lowercase letter.
The prefix can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
自定义连接地址的前辍：

由小写字母，数字，中划线组成，字母开头；
长度不超过30个字符
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix
